Below are two R scripts: the initial R script we converted to Quarto document during the workshop, and the helper R script for looping over multiple parameters.

### Initial R script

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
#| output: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# read data
monthly_losses_data <- read.csv('data/monthly_losses_data_20250601.csv')

# data cleaning - only interested in the county level data, convert date column to date
monthly_losses_data <- monthly_losses_data |> filter(geo_group == 'county') |> 
  mutate(date = as_date(date))

# total losses for the most recent month
losses <- monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == 'rainbowtrout') |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  pull(total_losses)

print(losses)

# table of percent changes over the last 12 months
monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == 'rainbowtrout') |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  mutate(pct_change = round((total_losses - lag(total_losses)) / lag(total_losses) * 100, 0)) |>
  filter(between(date, max(date) - months(12), max(date))) |>
  arrange(desc(date))


# chart of losses by county over the last 12 months
monthly_losses_data |>
  filter(species == 'rainbowtrout') |>
  group_by(region, date) |>
  summarize(total_losses = sum(losses)) |>
  filter(between(date, max(date) - months(12), max(date))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_losses, color = region, group = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Total losses", title = "Salmonid losses by county", subtitle = "Previous 12 months")
```

## R script for looping over multiple parameters

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
#| output: FALSE
library(quarto)

# Define your list of parameters
species <- c("rainbowtrout", "salmon")
date <- '20250601'

# Loop and render
for (s in species) {
  quarto::quarto_render(
    input = "SalmonidReport.qmd",
    execute_params = list(species = s, end_date = date),
    output_file = paste0("SalmonidReport_", s, "_", date, ".html")
  )
}

dates <- c("20250601", "20251201")

params = tidyr::crossing(
  species = species,
  end_date = dates
)

purrr::walk2(params$species, params$end_date, ~quarto::quarto_render(
  input = "SalmonidReport.qmd",
  execute_params = list("species" = .x,
                        "end_date" = .y),
  output_file = glue::glue("SalmonidReport_{.x}_{.y}.html")
))

# for 3 or more parameters, use purrr:pwalk instead of purrr:walk2
```
